title: Practice: a review specification that cuts false positives (TypeScript)

cases.id: m1 the prompt puts criteria first then examples then the diff last
cases.says: The prompt has criteria first, then examples, then the diff last, in the exact shape above

cases.id: e1 vague criteria are refused in both the report and the skip text
cases.says: Vague wording is refused in both the report and the skip text, with vague in the message

cases.id: e2 a criterion needs report skip and a concrete severity example for high and low
cases.says: A criterion needs a report, a skip and a severity example for high and low

cases.id: e3 two to four examples with a report and a skip each carrying a reason
cases.says: Two to four examples with a report and a skip, each with a reason and a known category

cases.id: e4 a category with enough reviews and low precision is disabled
cases.says: A category with enough reviews and low precision is disabled, and the boundaries hold

cases.id: e5 the most dismissed patterns are listed by count then name and capped at three
cases.says: The most dismissed patterns are listed by count and then name, capped at three

cases.id: e6 an attended run asks only what it cannot assume and states its assumptions
cases.says: An attended run asks only what it cannot assume and states its assumptions

cases.id: e7 an unattended run never asks it states assumptions or stops
cases.says: An unattended run never asks: it states assumptions or stops
